alt: Likes are a signal. Which numbers help you decide?
Likes show attention. They tell you something caught an eye. They do not tell you whether the business moved.
Match the number to the goal: Be seen; Spark interest; Get visits; Get orders
Before you read numbers: Pick one goal - For each post or ad.; Check tracking - Where do orders come from?; Ask customers - How did you find us?
Hypothetical example. A post that looks great: Many likes - It feels like a win.; Few link clicks - Few people visit the store.; The goal was orders - The numbers do not match.
Feelings vs goals. Judging by likes: Feels good; Orders stay unclear. Judging by goal: Number picked first; Compared over time
Ask four things: What was the goal?; Which number matches it?; Can I track it?; What will I change next?

caption:
Likes are a signal. Which numbers help you decide? 📊

Likes show that something caught attention, but they do not tell you whether it helped the business. The number to watch depends on the goal.

Want to be seen? Look at reach. Want interest? Look at saves and shares. Want visits? Look at link clicks. Want orders? Look at orders. Before you read any number, pick one goal, check that you can track where orders come from, and ask new customers how they found you.

The example in the carousel is hypothetical.
